structuredClone: Clone `value` by serializing and then deserializing it. `opts` may include a `transfer` list and an `interfaces` list.
constants: Numeric tags used in serialized values. Also available as `require('bare-structured-clone/constants')`.
StructuredCloneOptions.transfer: Objects to transfer rather than clone; each is detached from the original after cloning.
StructuredCloneOptions.interfaces: Serializable and transferable constructors to recognize when (de)serializing custom platform objects.
